text: In one minute, the Moon falls five metres. An apple falls that far in one second. Isaac Newton worked out why. The Moon is sixty times further from the Earth's centre than we are, so the pull on it is sixty times sixty weaker. Three thousand six hundred times. And the numbers matched. One pull, for apples and Moons.
